node.title: Información constitutiva
node.summary: An authorised decision creates a rule, mandate or responsibility.

relations: Some scheduling questions require an accountable declaration of ownership or policy before further data collection can resolve them.
La divergencia entre entrevistas puede deberse a error, sesgo o datos incompletos; no es por sí sola prueba lógica de un vacío declarativo.
Classifying what is missing can prevent a repository project from repeatedly asking for facts that no authority has yet established.
La imagen de las cajas es un recurso conceptual. No justifica inferir intenciones de ocultación ni que toda ausencia tenga una única causa.
Mission activation can create the ownership and decision boundaries that further information gathering would otherwise leave unresolved.
Se compara una práctica organizativa con una distinción informacional; no se afirma una derivación formal del ritual de activación.
A declaration about how performance will be judged can change both reported information and the behavior being observed.
El ejemplo ilustra una distinción; no demuestra el teorema o todos los mecanismos del paper Cost of Clarity.
An unresolved fact may call for observation, while an unresolved authority condition may call for a legitimate declaration before action can proceed.
No toda incertidumbre factual es política ni toda divergencia significa que faltaba una declaración.
Information that was never institutionally established differs from information that existed but cannot be recovered from the available record.
Ambas categorías pueden coexistir en una decisión; clasificarlas exige evidencia del caso.
A bounded provisional declaration can enable discovery without being mistaken for the binding ownership decision that the investigation is meant to inform.
No toda falta de información requiere declaración. La provisionalidad no autoriza efectos irreversibles ni elimina el coste de la decisión final.
Introducing an observation rule can change the behaviour being measured; the Tuxpan account makes the purpose and adoption of telemetry part of the causal story.
No toda medición es una declaración constitutiva ni el cambio de conducta demuestra por sí solo aceptación del sistema.
A locally supported answer from qualified evidence does not constitute an undeclared institutional fact or grant authority to act on it.
El estudio es matemático y sintético; no clasifica automáticamente toda ausencia de información empresarial.
Part II develops the distinction further: retrieving state-preserving records cannot by itself constitute an institutional fact that still requires an authorized declaration.
El ejemplo organizativo inspira una proposición condicionada; no se identifica con física cuántica ni con un clasificador universal de ausencias.
